title: CPMM qualification boundary and amount-local rejection
baseline: Current PR562 immutable-model evaluator; source-independent pinned integer vectors.
corpus: Finite adversarial identities, valid/invalid fee semantics, negative/zero/positive gross amounts.
gate: Unknown identity/state rejects route; expected economic rejection is reported per amount without claiming unsampled capacity.

title: Shared resource alias and sequential split
baseline: Best individually exact evaluated single path; same cost model and starting state.
corpus: 2 paths, one shared pool, then two different markets backed by one balance; both path orders.
gate: No double consumption; state read/write keys complete; joint result equals tiny exhaustive oracle within declared finite grid.

title: Incremental event-driven graph
baseline: Full recomputation on same bounded universe and event trace.
corpus: 1x/10x/100x synthetic arrival rates; duplicates, unrelated changes, hook/allowance changes, correction and restart.
gate: Same qualified candidates/evidence after each watermark; omissions only explicit budget truncation, no false completeness.

title: Fast state vs canonical state
baseline: Canonical committed replay; equal provider and compute budgets.
corpus: Provisional branch, sealed block, reorg, delayed available_at, provider outage and missing event.
gate: Generation/commitment separation; p99 arrival-to-evidence reported with reject/backfill costs; no hindsight advantage.

title: Claims and vault semantics
baseline: Independent product-specific conversions with no synthetic immediate liquidity.
corpus: Immediate shares, async claim, max-function special case, wrong maturity/condition and decimals.
gate: Strict units and rights match; multi-input/output conservation; future claims excluded from spendable cash.

title: Credit and collateral prefix constraints
baseline: Separate operations under identical initial equity and final obligations.
corpus: 2 financing terms, immediate check vs declared deferred window, cap reduction and interest accrual.
gate: Every required boundary feasible; debt/fee/residual closure; flash and term funding segregated.

title: Versioned intents and clearing
baseline: Individually feasible customer fills at same timestamp, state and budget.
corpus: 10 intents; hard/soft exclusivity, expired/cancelled order, unknown reactor, partial fills and fee allocation.
gate: Per-user constraints and no-worse comparator; no duplicate order consumption; feed coverage explicitly bounded.

title: Settlement-time capital
baseline: Per-domain prefunding with explicit repayment wait and rebalance cost.
corpus: 2 domains, 10 requests, timeout, proof error, duplicate reimbursement, conflicting root and trapped funds.
gate: Peak and time-integrated inventory measured by asset/domain; restart never makes unknown funds available.

title: Cross-product payoff equivalence
baseline: Same notional economic exposure without claiming identical tickers imply identical claims.
corpus: Index/basis mismatch, different maturity, funding cadence, expiry, market halt and failed hedge leg.
gate: No guaranteed-arbitrage label when residual exposure remains; stress margin and exit costs included.

title: Verified service unit economics
baseline: Local exact evaluator + local evidence distribution cost.
corpus: 3 synthetic suppliers; bad amount/state, stale hash, cheap slow answer, shared upstream, duplicate bill.
gate: Verification correctness and total delivery cost measured separately from demand; no real payments.

title: Mechanism response and competition
baseline: Fixed rule with equal information, customer orders and budgets.
corpus: Frozen flow conditional replay plus independent elastic-flow/crowding stress; subsidy removal.
gate: Per-user/LP/provider outcomes separated; no causal advantage claim from frozen order flow; losses retained.

title: Budgeted scale and product selection
baseline: Small admitted universe, local compute, full recomputation comparator.
corpus: 10/100/1000 market metadata; bounded active graph; full resource vector; 18 candidate portfolio; missing budget and empty data.
gate: Cost per fresh validated opportunity and workflow measured; finite optimum scope explicit; unknown outcome stays unknown.
